text: {"lessons":["My account fell from 94,418 to 88,172 overall, despite some monthly rebounds; I should judge progress over time and keep enough cash for near-term living expenses.","Selling Stocks D and E after steep losses turned those losses into realized losses; before selling, I should weigh each holding’s prospects and my risk limits rather than focus only on its purchase price.","Months without trades did not stop the account from declining, so I should review my holdings and diversification regularly, while avoiding unnecessary reactions to short-term moves."]}
